name: Armored Saber-Toothed Tiger
section: Chapter 5, The Town of Vallaki, N5 Arasek Stockyard
sourcePageKind: The publisher index identifies this chapter section. Its rules require book access.
errataEvidence: Official Curse of Strahd errata v1.1 revises the p. 115 training target to Strahd’s Vistani servants and deletes the description of recognition by smell and clothing. No mechanical stat changes in this erratum.
habitatEvidence: Editorial search terms that reflect the encounter on pp. 115, 116, 123, 124.
appearanceEvidence: The creature description or equipment in the printed encounter, with details from the new portrait.
artworkNote: New plain matte tan parchment portrait using Big Linda as the style reference.
sourceNotes: The first printing replaces the base armor, HP, and challenge. It gives 84 HP without a replacement Hit Dice formula.
The printed base block gives +6 to hit and +5 damage on both attacks. The adventure does not change either value.

Publisher errata changes p. 115 to target Strahd’s Vistani servants and removes recognition by scent and clothing from that paragraph. Page 116 of the first printing describes broader targeting and is not separately amended in the errata.
